messages:
kyle: Partner NodeWave wants a co-sell POC. Scope: Embed SDK in their app + hosted inference for NLU, SSO via SAML, dedicated capacity option, and answers to their security questionnaire. Sales asks for an ops runbook + rough pricing by EOD Friday. Link to their questionnaire: https://nodewave.example/qna :wave:
maria: Thanks Kyle. Can you confirm expected traffic? Sales mentioned ~50k tokens/day for MVP and spikes to 200k/day during demos. Also they want price delta hosted vs dedicated (monthly).
aj: We can cover this. Quick notes: hosted pricing ballpark for 50k/day is ~ $600/mo (depends on model), dedicated (small reserved) with 2x A10G equiv GPUs ~ $6k-$8k/mo plus infra. Need model family (embedding vs gen) + typical request seq len to tighten numbers. For embed SDK we recommend pinning a quantized embedding model.
sam: Security: NodeWave requires KMS integration + SOC2 evidence + SAML IdP metadata sample. Send me their questionnaire and the specific fields they flagged as "must-have". We'll mark the high-risk items.
jen: I can provision a sandbox tenant for the partner. Need partner admin email list and desired region (us-west/us-east/eu). We can include an example embed config for their devs: ```json
{
  "client_id": "nodewave-client",
  "tenant": "nodewave-sandbox",
  "model": "redwood-embed-v1-q4",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "auth": "api-key"
}
```
claire: I'll draft the POC runbook: onboarding checklist, SAML handshake steps, entitlements, test prompts, telemetry hooks (trace id + token-level cost), and a rollback plan if latency exceeds SLO. Should I put that in the partner repo or Confluence?
maria: Partner repo is fine for technical docs; Confluence for sales-readability. Both please. Also we need a short one-pager for the account execs.
deploy-bot: sandbox-tenant/nodewave-sandbox created in us-west-2 by jen at 2024-04-02T15:12:03Z :robot_face:
ops-bot: Reserved pool created: dedicated-nodewave-01 (2xA10G) — quota assigned: 60k tokens/day baseline, burst to 240k/day. Owner: aj.
aj: Confirming dedicated pool name and baseline. Two action items for engineering: 1) validate model memory fit for the quantized embedding (I need sample model size). 2) add automated fallback policy to hosted small-model if dedicated is overloaded.
sam: For the questionnaire, I pulled these red flags: "HSM requirement", "data residency EU", and "full audit logs retention 1y". HSM is doable via our KMS/HSM add-on but needs procurement sign-off. Data residency — we can host EU tenant but requires private deployment or approved EU region with contractual addendum.
jen: Collected partner admin emails: ops@nodewave.com, eng@nodewave.com. They're fine with us-west but prefer EU later. I've invited them to the sandbox.
claire: Draft runbook uploaded: https://git.internal/partners/nodewave/poc-runbook.md — includes SAML steps and test plan.
maria: Great. Sales asks for a headline estimate to share with NodeWave today: can someone paste the hosted vs dedicated numbers (high/low) in this thread so I can forward?
aj: Hosted: $400–$900/mo (model dependent) for 50k tokens/day. Dedicated: $6k–$9k/mo (2x GPUs reserved) + ingress/egress and entitlements. Add KMS/HSM + compliance add-on ~ $2k/mo if required. These are rough.
sam: Compliance costs: SOC2 evidence collection and legal addendum for EU data residency — expect one-time legal/engineering effort ~ 2–3 weeks. HSM procurement timeline depends on provider but budget it as lead time.
maria: Perfect. Final checklist for EOD:
- aj: refined cost estimate with model + seq len
- sam: initial answers to top-10 security Qs and note HSM/data residency blockers
- jen: confirm tenant invites + sample embed config shared with partner
- claire: runbook link + one-pager for sales
- kyle/maria: sync with NodeWave on SAML metadata and demo dates
kyle: I'll take demo scheduling and SAML metadata. Thanks all :thumbsup: Any blockers besides the HSM and EU residency?
aj: Potential perf hit if they insist on very long context windows — need to size GPUs accordingly. Otherwise clear.
sam: No other blockers. I'll start filling the questionnaire and flag anything new.
maria: I'll update Sales with today's estimate and link to runbook. Meeting with NodeWave scheduled Fri 10am PT.
kyle: Closing loop — I'll post notes after the Fri call.
